questions.question: At which ground did Eastern Storm record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Polokwane Oval — largest win by runs of 90, against Limpopo Lillies on 2013/10/12.

questions.question: Nadine Moodley set a database record (21/22 season, T20) with a value of 108. Which record is it?
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Highest Individual Score', held by Nadine Moodley.

questions.question: Who won CSA Women's Cricketer of the Year in the 2022/23 season?
Who has achieved the 50+ runs and 3+ wickets in a match double more times, Kirstie Thomson or Khushi Mistry?
questions.explanation: Kirstie Thomson: 3 times. Khushi Mistry: 1 times.

questions.question: In head-to-head List A meetings, who has the edge, Rhinos or Titans?
Who holds the record for 'Highest Individual Score' in the 24/25 season (List A)?
questions.explanation: Diedre van Rensburg holds it, with a total of 165.
